agent_assessment: Decision deferral primitive is implemented across all three surfaces (API, CLI, UI) and tracks the plan closely. Backend: DecisionStatusDeferred constant, MaxRevisitAfterDays=365, and RevisitAfter *string field landed in api/store/models.go (lines 451, 456, 494). UpdateDecisionHandler (api/heartbeat/handlers.go ~2113-2293) validates revisit_after format/past/horizon, enforces transition matrix (pending->deferred, deferred->deferred re-defer with [re-deferred] note, deferred->pending|accepted|rejected, blocks deferred->running|completed). Pending queue (api/heartbeat/handlers_pending.go) filters future-deferred and resurfaceDueDeferred() promotes due rows back to pending with the spec'd '[re-surfaced after defer] deferred YYYY-MM-DD -> revisit YYYY-MM-DD' note (lines 67-96). CLI: decision-defer subcommand with --revisit-after (required, validated client-side) and --notes; --status=deferred filter on decision-list. UI: StatusBadge has a deferred case (DecisionLogView.tsx:56-62) and revisit_after renders inline (line 892). All defer-related API and CLI tests run green. go vet clean on touched packages. No tracked diff observed (non-sandbox execution); implementation verified by reading working tree.
notes: Plan called for a dedicated 'Deferred' tab parallel to existing status tabs in DecisionLogView. The component does not have status-based tabs at all (only a context filter), so deferred entries are surfaced via badge + revisit_after column rather than a tab. Worth confirming with the operator whether the badge-only treatment is sufficient or whether a real tab is required.

PendingDecisionsPopover.tsx has no client-side deferred filter; it relies on the backend to exclude deferred rows from the pending list. That works, but means a stale client cache could briefly show deferred entries. Plan accepted this trade-off.

evidence.title: API transition handler enforces defer matrix
evidence.description: api/heartbeat/handlers.go UpdateDecisionHandler (~lines 2113-2293) validates revisit_after as YYYY-MM-DD, rejects past dates and >365 day horizon, allows pending->deferred, deferred->deferred (re-defer with [re-deferred] audit note), deferred->pending|accepted|rejected, and rejects deferred->running|completed.

evidence.title: Pending queue filters and resurfaces deferred decisions
evidence.description: api/heartbeat/handlers_pending.go calls resurfaceDueDeferred() before fetching pending (lines 14-61). resurfaceDueDeferred (lines 67-96) promotes deferred rows whose revisit_after <= today, flips status to pending, clears revisit_after, and appends note '[re-surfaced after defer] deferred YYYY-MM-DD -> revisit YYYY-MM-DD' — exactly the spec'd format.
